biggest_catch: The $89 annual fee is waived the first year, so your year-one net bonus value is the full $250 — but from year two the fee applies every year, so decide before month 12 whether the card earns its keep or cancel it before the fee hits.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never overspend just to chase a bonus; buying things to hit a threshold wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on this.

The bonus pays in two tiers: 15,000 miles after your first purchase within 6 months, plus 10,000 more only if your total net purchases reach $3,000 within 6 months — total 25,000 miles ($250 cash-back value).
Miles post within six to eight weeks after each criterion is met — expect a slow payout.
The $89 annual fee is waived the first year and applies from year two onward; cancel or downgrade before the anniversary if it no longer earns its keep.
Not available if you are responding to another offer or previously received a promotional bonus on this or another TD account.
Eligibility includes minimum income, residency, age, and credit-quality requirements.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily dip your credit score by a few points.
The card's variable APR (around 20%+) will erase the entire bonus in a month or two if you carry a balance — pay the full statement balance every month.

steps: Go to the official TD First Class terms page https://www.tdbank.com/firstclass/terms-and-conditions.html/1000 and read both bonus tiers.
Apply online and get approved; save your approval confirmation.
Make your first purchase within six months to lock in the 15,000-mile tier.
Reach $3,000 in total net purchases — your already-planned spending — within six months to unlock the extra 10,000 miles.
Pay the full statement balance every month so interest never eats the bonus.
Confirm both tiers post within six to eight weeks after each criterion is met.
Before month 12, decide whether the card earns its $89 fee going forward; if not, cancel or downgrade before the anniversary.
